description: Machine-readable contract published by the buyer agent: the desired outcome, budget, deliverables, acceptance tests, and payment policy.

acceptance_tests.description: Checks the evidence must pass before payment can be captured. Deterministic checks and AI-evaluator gates are both listed here.

budget.description: Maximum total provider cost the buyer approves.

deliverables.description: Artifacts the provider team must produce.

goal.description: The desired outcome in plain language.

approval_threshold_usd.description: Amounts above this always require explicit human approval, even if verification passes.

capture_after_verification.description: Payment is captured only after all acceptance tests pass.

human_approval_required.description: A human must approve the verified outcome before capture.

title: OutcomePay Outcome Contract
